$comment: What coworkee update knows about each Coworkee version: breaking changes of website/docs/reference/changelog.md, automatic renames, one-line insertions and package bumps, manual steps with the code they concern. A version's rules apply when an app moves past it.

breaking: Coworkee.Testing: PostgresFixture is now DatabaseFixture (Postgres, SQL Server or SQLite through COWORKEE_TEST_DATABASE) and PostgresWebApplicationFactory is now DatabaseWebApplicationFactory.

manual.text: DatabaseFixture.ConnectionString is set in InitializeAsync; fixtures that passed the connection string themselves use fixture.Settings(connectionStringName) now.

breaking: Aspire 13.6.1: the app host SDK and Aspire.Hosting.Testing move to 13.6.1.
The web host needs app.UseWebAssemblyDebugging() in Development, otherwise Visual Studio cannot attach to the browser (wss://.../_framework/debug/ws-proxy).

manual.text: Add `if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment()) { app.UseWebAssemblyDebugging(); }` before the app is mapped in the web host.

breaking: Mail: IMailTransport (SMTP, SendGrid, Mailgun, Mailchimp Transactional) replaces ISmtpTransport.
GET /api/v1/services returns { services, unavailableSources } instead of a list.
Theming: the theme property LogoSvg is now Logo (SVG markup or an image data URL); the column is renamed, add a migration.
Removed with MudBlazor.Extensions 9.11.3: ChipListEditor, CronEditor, CronSchedule and SettingsFormRules.WrapInColumns; lists of strings render as MudExTagField<string>, [Cron] renders MudExCronEdit.
.NET packages 10.0.13 (the advisories of 2026-10-13 fail builds with NU1903 on 10.0.12).

manual.text: Implement IMailTransport instead of ISmtpTransport (SendAsync gets the whole message and the transport settings).
GET /api/v1/services answers { services, unavailableSources }; read .services.
ChipListEditor, CronEditor and CronSchedule are gone: use MudExTagField<string> (or RenderAsChips) and MudExCronEdit ([Cron]).

breaking: IMailSender requires the six-parameter QueueAsync(to, template, model, culture, campaignId, cancellationToken).
IMailTemplateRenderer gained RenderContentAsync(content, layout, model, cancellationToken).
Positional records gained parameters: MailTemplateSummaryDto (IsCustom, Description), MailTemplateDto (IsCustom), OutgoingMailDto (CampaignId); regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.
Mail campaigns, recipient lists and own templates change the model: add a migration.

manual.text: Own IMailSender implementations implement the six-parameter QueueAsync (with campaignId).
Own IMailTemplateRenderer implementations add RenderContentAsync.
Pass the new positional parameters (IsCustom, Description, CampaignId).

breaking: ClientEntityIndicator removed: mirrored tables show the ClientEntitySwitch in their tool bar.
ODataPicker.Margin and OptionalODataPicker.Margin are Margin? now.
CliOption gained DependsOn and OptionDependency gained Or (binary incompatible for tools compiled against an older Coworkee.Cli.Spec).
LoadingScreenDto gained the positional parameter SignedIn; regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.
Enums in every MudExObjectEdit render with the EnumEditor.
Every app shows the loading screen: one line as the first line of <body> in App.razor of the web host.
Public files: StoredFile.IsPublic; apps with the Files module add a migration.

manual.text: Delete <ClientEntityIndicator> and an own Compare button: the ClientEntitySwitch is in the tool bar.
ODataPicker.Margin is Margin? now: add ?? Margin.Dense where it is read as Margin.
Pass SignedIn to LoadingScreenDto.

breaking: ICoworkeeApi gained AddMailTemplateLanguageAsync, GetPushSettingsAsync, SavePushSubscriptionAsync and DeletePushSubscriptionAsync; own implementations add them.
Notification derives from AggregateRoot (it raises NotificationCreated for Web Push); no schema change from that.
IODataClient.ExportAsync and ImportAsync are removed: exports and the import wizard go through IDataTransferApi.
ODataImportRegistration has Create, Update and Delete instead of Send; AddODataImport takes (Guid? id, row) => command and an optional delete command.

CoworkeeODataModule depends on CoworkeeBackgroundJobsModule (imports and large exports run as jobs); test hosts with OData set Coworkee:Jobs:ConnectionStringName and create their tables before UseCoworkee().
New tables cw.PushSubscriptions (Notifications), cw.DataTransferJobs and cw.ImportProfiles (OData): add a migration. Workflows and Webhooks bring their own tables when an app adds them.
Phone layout: the viewport tag of App.razor needs viewport-fit=cover.
New endpoints for push, mail template languages, import/export, history, workflows and webhooks: regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.

Library pages live under /cw/admin/... instead of /admin/... (CoworkeeClientOptions.PagePrefix, "" keeps the old addresses); one catch-all page (/{*Path}) renders them, so an app page with its own catch-all route is ambiguous. Old addresses redirect.
ICoworkeeApi gained GetSystemStatusAsync; own implementations add it.
IWorkflowApi gained GetStatesAsync (POST /api/v1/workflows/{entityType}/states); own implementations add it.
Webhooks: two new columns on cw.WebhookSubscriptions (secret rotation); apps with webhooks add a migration.
KeycloakRealm moved from Aspire.Hosting to Coworkee.Contracts.Identity.

Deployments take the app host's tools along: Migrations/Program.cs seeds InitialAdmin and reconciles the Keycloak realm, ServiceDefaults exports to Grafana per signal (GRAFANA_OTLP_PROTOCOL), AppHost.cs uses app.Deploys(...) and aspireUi.WithCoworkee(app).
SyncDevelopmentUsersAsync() (Development only) keeps the seed users of an existing database in step; the migrations host calls it after SeedCoworkeeIdentityAsync().

manual.text: Own ICoworkeeApi implementations add AddMailTemplateLanguageAsync, GetPushSettingsAsync, SavePushSubscriptionAsync and DeletePushSubscriptionAsync.
IODataClient.ExportAsync/ImportAsync are gone: use IDataTransferApi; own IODataClient fakes drop the two methods.
ODataImportRegistration.Send is now Create/Update/Delete; for updates and undo pass (Guid? id, row) => command and id => delete command to AddODataImport.
Test hosts with OData need Coworkee:Jobs:ConnectionStringName (RunServer=false) and their tables created before UseCoworkee().

Links to library admin pages move to /cw/admin/... (old addresses redirect); an own catch-all page (@page "/{*...}") clashes with the library one: give it a prefix or set CoworkeeClientOptions.PagePrefix.
Own ICoworkeeApi implementations add GetSystemStatusAsync.
Own IWorkflowApi implementations add GetStatesAsync.
KeycloakRealm is in Coworkee.Contracts.Identity now: add using Coworkee.Contracts.Identity;.

Seed the first administrator of a deployment: var admin = InitialAdmin.From(builder.Configuration); AddCoworkeeIdentitySeed(IsDevelopment ? DemoSeed.Configure : o => DemoSeed.ConfigureDeployment(o, admin!)); seed only in Development or with an admin, then call host.Services.SyncDevelopmentUsersAsync() and scope.ServiceProvider.ReconcileKeycloakRealmAsync() (see the template Migrations/Program.cs).

Grafana exporter per signal: with GRAFANA_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf use {endpoint}/v1/{logs|metrics|traces} over HttpProtobuf, exporters grafana-logs/-metrics/-traces (see the template ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs).

App host: add Ollama when app.Deploys(CoworkeeTools.Ollama) and AspireUI when app.Deploys(CoworkeeTools.AspireUI) with builder.AddAspireUI().WithCoworkee(app).WithRetrieveApi() (seed from the directory only in run mode) instead of IsRunMode checks.

breaking: Reporting: new table cw.DashboardReports (a report as dashboard): apps with Reporting add a migration.
IReportsApi gained GetDashboardAsync and SetDashboardAsync; own implementations add them. New endpoints under /api/v1/reports/dashboard: regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.

AddCommandPaletteEntitySet and CommandPaletteEntitySet<T> are removed: the command palette finds records through the global search of the server; register the set there with services.AddGlobalSearch<T>(s => s.Fields(...).Page(...)).
ICoworkeeApi gained GetMailTemplateHistoryAsync; own implementations add it.
MudBlazor.Extensions 9.11.4 and MudExRichTextEditor 9.5.5 (TipTap is the default rich text editor, setting Editors.RichTextEditor): apps that pin these packages move up.

Elsa endpoints (/api/elsa) no longer appear in the OpenAPI document: apps with Coworkee.Workflows.Elsa regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs. New optional template option elsaStudio (Elsa Studio host, AddElsaStudio).

manual.text: Own IReportsApi implementations add GetDashboardAsync and SetDashboardAsync.
Show the report chosen as dashboard: wrap the app's dashboard page in <ReportDashboard> (Coworkee.Client.Blazor.Reporting.Components); it falls back to its child content.

Move the palette search of the set to the server module that registers its OData set: services.AddGlobalSearch<TEntity>(s => s.Fields(e => e.Name).Subtitle(...).Page("/list-page")), then delete the client registration.
Own ICoworkeeApi implementations add GetMailTemplateHistoryAsync.

breaking: Chat: direct and group conversations; new tables cw.ChatConversations, cw.ChatMembers, cw.ChatReactions, cw.ChatAttachments and new columns of cw.ChatMessages: apps with Chat add a migration. Earlier direct messages move into conversations at the next start.
Coworkee.Chat depends on Coworkee.Storage (attachments) and references Coworkee.Notifications (mention notifications when the module is there).

ChatMessageDto.ToUserId is nullable (empty in groups) and has new init properties; ChatReadDto has ConversationId. IChatApi gained the conversation members; own implementations add them. New endpoints under /api/v1/chat/chats, /messages and /attachments: regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.

UserAvatar offers a chat menu on click (OfferChat, default true); set OfferChat="false" where the avatar sits in something that reacts to clicks. New library page person at /people/{id}: an app page with that address wins, or replace it with options.Pages.Replace("person", ...).

manual.text: Own IChatApi implementations add the conversation members (GetChatsAsync, OpenDirectAsync, PostAsync, ...).
Test bases that render the layout without AddCoworkeeClient register Coworkee.Client.Blazor.Chat.ChatDock (scoped).

breaking: The app host runs the migrations of a local run as Development; their host validates its services then and fails on the MVC services of OData (IWebHostEnvironment). The migrations project builds its container with the production defaults.

The migrations host, the security headers of the web host and its upload limit come from the library (AddCoworkeeMigrations/RunCoworkeeMigrationsAsync, UseCoworkeeSecurityHeaders, Coworkee:Bff:MaxRequestBodySize); hand-written copies keep working but no longer get the fixes.

Theming: a filtered unique index on cw.Themes.Name for the built-in themes (TenantId null) keeps a second app instance from seeding them twice on SQL Server and SQLite; add a migration. Earlier versions removed such duplicates at every start; if the migration still reports a duplicate key on IX_Themes_Name, delete the extra built-in row first.

Chat: the column cw.ChatAttachments.ThumbnailKey holds the small WebP of a picture; add a migration. Coworkee.Chat depends on Coworkee.BackgroundJobs (an hourly job deletes files uploaded but never sent) and brings SkiaSharp with its native Linux assets.

History restore: POST /api/v1/history/{set}/{id}/restore needs the version of its preview (EntityHistoryRestoreRequest.Version from EntityHistoryPreviewDto.Version) and answers 409 when the record changed since; regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs. EntityHistoryRestoreDialog.ConfirmAsync does it for the Blazor UI.

manual.text: Replace the hand-written migrations host with the library's: builder.AddCoworkeeMigrations<TDbContext>(o => { o.DevelopmentSeed = DemoSeed.Configure; o.DeploymentSeed = DemoSeed.ConfigureDeployment; }) and return await host.RunCoworkeeMigrationsAsync(); it brings InitialAdmin, the seed, SyncDevelopmentUsersAsync, ReconcileKeycloakRealmAsync, Migrations:Attempts and the container fix of 0.0.1.32 (see the template Migrations/Program.cs).
Add app.UseCoworkeeSecurityHeaders(); before UseStaticFiles in the web host and remove a hand-written Content-Security-Policy middleware (extra sources: Coworkee:Bff:SecurityHeaders:Sources).
Remove the hand-written Kestrel MaxRequestBodySize: the BFF's forwarded routes take any size and the API checks its own limits (cap: Coworkee:Bff:MaxRequestBodySize).
Tests that start the migrations host against an unreachable database set Migrations__Attempts=1: RunCoworkeeMigrationsAsync retries 20 times 3 seconds by default.
Own IEntityHistoryApi implementations return the preview's Version and pass EntityHistoryRestoreRequest.Version on to the restore endpoint.
Direct calls of the restore endpoint send the version of a preview first: request with { Version = preview.Version }.

breaking: Passkeys: the new table cw.UserPasskeys keeps the passkeys of the users (ASP.NET Core Identity schema version 3); add a migration.

manual.text: Own ICoworkeeApi implementations add ResetUserPasskeysAsync.

Optional: Coworkee.Retention sets how long data is kept (admin page Retention, nightly cleanup). Add the package to the infrastructure project, typeof(Coworkee.Retention.CoworkeeRetentionModule) to the DependsOn of the database module and a migration (cw.RetentionRuns).

breaking: Workflows: the new column RequestedBy of cw.WorkflowApprovals; add a migration in apps with Coworkee.Workflows.
Social: the new table cw.Reactions; add a migration in apps with Coworkee.Social. Comments, tags, ratings and reactions now follow the row visibility of the entity's OData set.
Error.Validation(field, message).Message is the given message instead of the generic text.
Record attachments: IRecordAttachments.PutAsync, DeleteAsync and DeleteAllAsync no longer save; outside a command call IUnitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync.
Workflows: ApprovalStep.ApprovedState and RejectedState are nullable (null for targets chosen from the entity; see ApprovedTargets/RejectedTargets).

manual.text: PageHeader and CoworkeeDataTable.CreateText translate themselves: pass text keys instead of @L["..."].

Web clients with .razor.css files: link the scoped CSS bundle in App.razor after the MudBlazor.Extensions stylesheet: <link href="@Assets["MyApp.Web.styles.css"]" rel="stylesheet" /> (your web project name).
API tests of apps with the RabbitMQ event bus: builder.UseSetting("Coworkee:EventBus:RabbitMq:Enabled", "false") in the test host delivers integration events in process.

breaking: MudBlazor.Extensions 9.11.5: apps that pin the package move up.

Reporting: the new tables cw.ReportSubscriptions (report subscriptions) and cw.OutgoingMailAttachments (Mailing, files of queued mails); add a migration in apps with Coworkee.Reporting. CoworkeeReportingModule now depends on CoworkeeMailingModule.
DateRanges moved from Coworkee.Client.Blazor.Reporting.State to Coworkee.Contracts.Reporting.
MudBlazor.Extensions 9.11.6: apps that pin the package move up.

manual.text: DateRanges is in Coworkee.Contracts.Reporting now: add using Coworkee.Contracts.Reporting; where it is called directly.

breaking: Groups form a tree: cw.Groups gets ParentId and Code, the name is unique per parent, new table cw.GroupSelections; add a migration (the migrations host gives existing groups their codes). SetGroupMembers needs Identity.Groups.ManageMembers (implied by Manage).

ICoworkeeApi has new group members (GetGroupChildrenAsync, SearchGroupTreeAsync, MoveGroupAsync, AddGroupMembersAsync, RemoveGroupMembersAsync, MoveGroupMembersAsync, GetMyGroupsAsync, SelectGroupsAsync): hand-written implementations and test fakes add them.
IUnitOfWork resolves to a wrapper that also saves external DbContexts, no longer to the DbContext itself; code that cast it to a DbContext injects the context instead.
Aspire 13.6.4: the app host SDK, Aspire.Hosting.* and Aspire.Hosting.Testing move to 13.6.4, the CommunityToolkit Aspire packages to 13.6.1.
Nextended 10.1.48: apps that pin Nextended packages move up.

Log in as another user: cw.AuditEntries and cw.OutboxMessages get the nullable column ImpersonatorId (same migration). ICoworkeeApi has the new member StartImpersonationAsync. Only auth clients with AllowImpersonation (Coworkee:Auth:Clients:<n>:AllowImpersonation; the web host of the app host has it) serve an impersonated user.

manual.text: Implement StartImpersonationAsync and the new ICoworkeeApi group members in hand-written implementations and test fakes (throw NotImplementedException where a fake does not need them).

breaking: CodeCompletion.InsertText is the whole text including the trigger ({{ name }} instead of " name }}"); a pick replaces the typed trigger and the closing brackets Monaco added.

manual.text: Put the trigger into the InsertText of own CodeCompletion items passed to CodeEditor ("{{ name }}" instead of " name }}").
